title: Inductive-iris band-pass filter: three WR-90 cavities, passband 9.75–10.25 GHz
source: Mode matching of TE_m0 modes at the eight iris faces, cascaded as generalised scattering matrices through irises and cavities (Uher, Bornemann, Rosenberg, Waveguide Components for Antenna Feed Systems: Theory and CAD, Artech House 1993, ch. 2), converged with 640 modes (changes below 1e-4 from 320). The filter's dimensions are our own, chosen with the same mode matching

quantities.reason: in the passband the transmission is nearly total whatever the small resonance shift
a small reflection between the filter's two reflection zeros: the 8e-3 complex error of the graded mesh is a fifth of it
on the skirt |S21| falls 25 dB per GHz: a resonance shift of 0.05 % moves it by 0.1 dB
measured 8e-3 with elements of 3 mm graded to 0.3 mm at the 16 iris edges; the resonant filter magnifies small shifts in the irises' susceptances
